## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the phone with rounded edges on the brown angled plastic phonestand.

Task description: Move the rounded phone, screen up at the front of the table, onto the tilted brown plastic phone stand behind it.

Success criteria: The phone is at the stand's support position, close to the intended placement in left-right, front-back, and height, and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the straight upper-middle sections of the phone's long edges, away from the rounded corners, leaving room for its lower end to seat on the stand support.
- Open slightly wider than the phone along the grasp direction. Confirm the fingers straddle it and pads can contact its edges before closing, avoiding image-only overlap while actually pressing the screen or table.
- Adjust the phone tilt to the stand's slope, with its back facing the slope and lower end toward the support. Leave finger-to-stand clearance to reduce jamming or pushing the phone out of alignment.
- Before release, confirm the phone's bottom edge is supported and its back has support, avoiding a drop while it is still suspended.
